name: ReceivablesAgingBoard
tagline: The Receivables Aging Board turns a list of open invoices into a collections workspace.
description: The Receivables Aging Board turns a list of open invoices into a collections workspace. Every invoice is aged against a reference date (normally today) and placed in an aging bucket such as Current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90 or 90+ days overdue. You see the total position at the top and each customer underneath, and you can open any invoice behind the numbers.
features: Configurable aging buckets (e.g. Current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+) against a reference date
KPI strip (outstanding, overdue, % overdue, weighted days overdue)
Customer rows with mini aging bars and expandable invoice lists, search
